title: Initial administrator setup
description: The first request creates the only initial administrator and organization.

title: Session login
description: A valid account receives an HttpOnly session and the password is not returned.

title: Invalid login
description: An incorrect password is rejected with the same message used for an unknown email.

title: Project management
description: Users can create and list projects stored in PostgreSQL.

title: Input sources
description: A project can store a website source without storing the password in the source configuration.

title: Target and archive safety
description: Blocked network targets and archive paths that escape the destination are rejected.

title: AI credential storage
description: Provider API keys are encrypted and ordinary responses show only a hint.

title: AI connection test
description: A provider is marked connected only after its model endpoint returns a recognized JSON payload.

title: Website discovery
description: Playwright records pages inside the allowed host and stores PNG screenshots.

title: Static source analysis
description: ZIP and Git sources are inspected without executing the uploaded code, and route findings use real line numbers.

title: Failed jobs stay failed
description: A job that cannot start analysis is stored as failed and is not reported as completed.

title: Job retry
description: Retrying a failed job increments the retry count and runs the pipeline again.

title: Cooperative pause
description: A pause request stops the pipeline before the next step and keeps the job paused.

title: Verification rules
description: Verified status requires every mandatory criterion to pass. A failed criterion blocks that status.

title: Document generation
description: Markdown, HTML, PDF, and DOCX exports open and contain the document title.

title: Document versions
description: A later analysis run keeps earlier document versions available.

title: Organization isolation
description: A user in another organization cannot read a project.

title: Secret redaction
description: Secret assignments are removed from exported text.

title: WordPress draft publishing
description: A post is recorded only after WordPress confirms it, and the same request is not sent twice.

title: Video rendering
description: ffmpeg produces a readable MP4 with a positive duration from captured screenshots.

title: Manual change detection
description: A new analysis run compares file hashes with the previous run. There is no live monitor.

title: Readiness checks
description: Readiness reports database, Redis, and storage independently.

title: Provider adapters
description: OpenRouter, Gemini, OpenAI, and OpenAI-compatible adapters build their own requests. Pricing is read from provider fields.

title: Provider endpoint safety
description: Provider base URLs are rejected when they target metadata or link-local addresses.

title: Paid fallback guard
description: A failed provider is not replaced by another provider unless paid fallback is explicitly enabled.

title: Oxion AI provider
description: Oxion AI can be connected with only an API key. The official base URL and model discovery are applied automatically.

title: Test database isolation
description: The automated suite truncates only a database whose name ends with _test.

title: Verification evidence is separate
description: Importing a test report stores a historical run and does not change requirement row status.

title: SEO article draft
description: An article stores the SEO fields and labels template output separately from model output.

title: Voiceover boundary
description: Missing speech synthesis does not create audio or mark a video as voice-enabled.

title: Video source labeling
description: A slideshow is labeled as screenshots and is not described as a browser interaction recording.

title: Multiple website accounts
description: A website source can store more than one account, and passwords are not returned.

title: Scheduled monitoring
description: An enabled due schedule queues one rescan and does not queue another while a job is unfinished.
